notes.title: THE SOUNDTRACK GAME BUNDLE IS HERE!
notes.content:
THE SOUNDTRACK GAME BUNDLE IS HERE!

As we stride forth into the future of this game’s release, we’re also bringing you a bundle to buy that includes BOTH the game and the original soundtrack, composed by Greg Nicolett. You may know his work from the incredible score of Potionomics by Voracious Games. The Skystrider score also includes stellar vocalist Laura Intravia, and cellist Polina Faustova. This music brings the world of Skystrider to life beyond measure, and now you can grab it to accompany the game! 

ASCEND!

A resounding thank you to those that have played Skystrider in the first few weeks of its release! Thank you to those of you as well that left reviews with lovely thoughts and helpful feedback. We want this game to feel loved and welcome in your game libraries, and your insightful input really helps us do that!  

We’re releasing an update in September to address a number of QOL features, bugs called out by our users, and more. These changes are outlined below–

[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect tutorial icons for controller ‘attack’ and ‘dodge’ inputs in combat tutorial
[*] Additional tutorialization for ‘teleport dots’ in level 3 and for thrown weapon in level 2
[*] Removed ramp in combat tutorial that had issues with clipping while dashing
[*] Fixed bug where music in level 3 wouldn’t trigger
[*] Pruned save points to avoid level streaming issues in level 1
[*] Improved continue button start-up speed
[*] Fixed the continue button not working in the menu*
[*] Pause menu now bound to both P and Escape
[*] Loading screen includes new tips and tutorial messages
[/list]

*If you have this issue with the continue button currently, you will need to start a new game. Your old save data is corrupted.

notes.title: Skystrider Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44126304/0d3904cc6b609cc1bb373b23bdec6139f6b5b34c.jpg[/img]

After years of hard work—designing, rendering, physics testing, bug fixing, and so much more—we are incredibly proud to announce that Skystrider has officially released!

To everyone who supported us throughout this journey, thank you! We hope you enjoy playing. Skystrider is available for purchase on Steam, playable on PC and Steamdeck. 🚀

notes.title: Skystrider Demo Released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KVoH6YZcUfE;full][/previewyoutube]

We are thrilled to announce that the demo for Skystrider is now available for download! This is the result of two years of hard work and passion, and we can’t wait for you to experience it. This is just a taste of what’s to come, as we are working on the full release, which will have even more content, features, and surprises. But for now, enjoy the demo and let us know what you think! We appreciate your feedback and support, and we hope you have fun playing Skystrider!
